en.title: Minimum Days to Ship Equal Amounts From All Non-empty Centers Each Day
en.description:
Each day, choose a positive integer x and ship exactly x parcels from every center that still has parcels. x cannot exceed the current remaining amount of any non-empty center, and empty centers do not take part. Find the minimum number of days to ship all parcels. If everything is 0 at the start, the answer is 0 days.

The standard I/O, examples and editorial were written independently by this site; ranges explicitly marked as this site's are not the source's original constraints.
en.input: The first line contains n and the second line contains parcels. 1≤n≤1000000, 0≤parcels[i]≤10^9; the original million-sized range is kept.
en.output: Output a single integer, the answer.
en.explanation: The answers are 3, 1 and 0 respectively. In the first example you can ship 2, 1 and then 1 parcels from every non-empty center.
hints: The answer is the number of distinct positive stock values. Convert each token to an integer and add it to a set, without keeping a separate full integer array.
